services.desc: Dinner is fine. Dinner is also what everyone defaults to when nobody has a better idea - two people across a table, working to think of things to say. A comedy show is a plan. You sit next to each other instead of across from each other, something happens, and afterwards you have something to talk about that isn't work. Ninety minutes, doors an hour before, dinner from BBQ4LIFE if you want it, and a bar that stocks real non-alcoholic options alongside the usual. A 7:00 show has you out by around 8:30, which leaves the rest of the evening open rather than eating it. It's a 150+ seat room, so there's no bad seat and nobody's watching from the back of a hall. blurb: Originally hailing from San Francisco, CA, Caitlin Peluffo is a comedian based in NYC. After a brief six year stint in art school studying performative video art (no, really…that’s a thing) Caitlin expanded her talents to the stage. She’s opened for comedians, Maria Bamford, Fortune Feimster, Matteo Lane, and Brian Regan.
